routes.card: Card → ETH on Ethereum → transfer to SORA → swap ETH for XOR in your wallet. You need only a SORA wallet: a temporary Ethereum wallet on this page sends the ETH to SORA for you. MoonPay controls eligibility, identity checks, minimums and final fees.
routes.ethereum: ETH or USDT on Ethereum mainnet → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR in your wallet. Existing Ethereum DAI skips conversion. Keep ETH for network fees.
routes.ton: Native TON first needs an external TON-to-USDT swap. USDT on TON → ETH on Ethereum through Symbiosis → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR in your wallet. The provider handles the TON transfer and its recovery. Keep TON and ETH for network fees.
routes.sora: DAI in your SORA wallet → swap to XOR. The estimate accounts for the SORA swap fee.

steps.walletsEthereum: Connect an Ethereum wallet, like MetaMask, and a SORA wallet. You can create a SORA wallet on the next screen.
steps.walletsTon: Connect your TON, Ethereum and SORA wallets.
steps.card: Pay by card in MoonPay. MoonPay sends ETH to a temporary wallet on this page.
steps.ton: Move your USDT from TON to Ethereum in the provider’s app.
steps.convert: In your Ethereum wallet, approve the swap to DAI and the transfer to SORA.
steps.sendCard: The page sends the ETH to SORA for you.
steps.transfer: In your Ethereum wallet, approve the transfer of your DAI to SORA.
steps.swap: In your SORA wallet, approve the swap to XOR. Your XOR arrives in that wallet.
